title: Line sketch: Psychedelic Swirling Color Waves
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: An abstract composition of flowing swirls, spirals, and organic wave forms that overlap and intertwine across the entire frame. Bold, saturated hues blend and layer with fluid, creating a sense of constant motion and depth. The technique emphasizes vibrant color transitions and rhythmic curves without any representational elements (derived from painting #146).
